name: instagram-ai-plugin
description: Drive your own Instagram account from the terminal with your browser session (no Graph API app, no Apify): sign in with cookies; read profiles, posts, comments and hashtags; publish photos, carousels, reels and stories, and comment and reply, as approved dry runs; and run content, audit, competitor research and ads workflows on real account data.

interface.shortDescription: Publish, read and analyze your Instagram account with your browser session
interface.longDescription: Sign in to Instagram with your own browser cookies and use the same endpoints instagram.com uses: read profiles, posts, reels, comments and hashtags; publish photos, carousels, reels and stories, and comment and reply, after an approved dry run; write and lint captions, hooks and reel scripts; audit an account against its own median; build a swipe file from competitors; and plan Instagram ad campaigns.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Instagram account and tell me what to post more of
Write a caption for this reel and lint it
Post this carousel to Instagram (show me the dry run first)
